one_line_description: Devin is an autonomous AI software engineer that can write, run and test code, and is part of a larger ecosystem of tools and protocols for integrating AI into software development workflows.
auth_notes: Devin uses a principal + token model for authentication, with service users and personal access tokens available.
gate_detail: Devin uses a self-serve model, with users able to create and manage their own sessions and tasks.

evidence.quote_snippet: The Devin API uses a principal + token model. A principal is who you are (your identity), and a token is how you prove it (your credential).
The Devin Desktop API enables enterprise customers to programmatically access detailed usage analytics and manage usage configurations for their teams.
Devin self-serve plans: Free $0, Pro $20/mo, Max $200/mo, all single-seat.
